The damage is more severe than we know...
Everybody, let's split up!\nFind the way we can use with less risk!!
Hey, anything wrong?
Hmm? Oh, nothing. It just feels nostalgic...\nI used to train here to be a knight.
I shut my eyes, sealed my magic, and lived by only\nrelying on my hearing and instinct while\npracticing my sword.
Whaaat?!\nI'm impressed that you survived this place!
I can't even walk properly with my eyes open.
I slipped a lot and almost fell too when I just\ngot here.
Just when I was about to give up, a strange guy\nwho said he lived here helped me...
Since then, he would give me food or helped me\nwhen I was really in danger.
I wonder how he's doing now...
This is Shampy's territory!\nWhat are you guys here for?!
Shampy??
Hey!\nWhat the heck is this all of a sudden!!
Shampy lost...\nShampy is annoyed...
Hey!\nWe met someone like you the other day.\nHow are you guys related?
So it was you guys who helped Shampy's friends?\nThey said you were so helpful. Shampy is grateful!
Wait, what?\nWhat do you mean?
Shampies spread hyphae and spores through the air\nand are connected to one another.
The Shampy you helped told another Shampy right\naway and eventually all Shampies will know about\nit.
So that means there are other Shampies too and\nthere's a communication network made of hyphae\nand spores that
Shampies use to share information with one\nanother...
Shampy! Is that you Shampy?!
Laureraz...Laureraz!
It's been a while!\nSo you've become a knight!!
What!!\nYou know each other?!
Ooh, this unique voice and the feeling of this\ntouch...I have no doubt about it. He was the one\nthat helped me a lot during my training.
Well, that explains it. You only knew him by his\nvoice and his touch, you didn't see what he looks\nlike, so you didn't think he was a monster...
What are you guys here for?
We wanna go to Dikkit Sector, but all the other\npossible ways have become inaccessible...
If you're going to Dikkit from here, then going\nthrough Labilans would be the shortest route.
I'll show you the safe way.\nFollow me!
Shampy, wait...
Sorry, but could you go and tell the captain that\nwe have found the safest way?
Shampy's territory ends here.\nShampy can't go further.\nAre you guys gonna be fine?
It's all right!\nGetting us here is already more than enough!!
Thanks for showing us the way.\nYou've been a big help...
Thanks, Shampy...
Will you come to see me again?
Oh, absolutely!\nOnce we drive out the enemies that are occupying\nEldenbaum!!
Thank you.\nPlease say hi to the Shampy that knows us!
